text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown schedules QA & testing from Mar 1 to Mar 20, 2027.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p2-s3","quote":"QA & testing | Mar 1 - Mar 20, 2027"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown gives the public launch date as March 15, 2027, which falls before the end of its QA window on Mar 20, 2027, so QA would not finish before launch under that schedule.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p2-s3","quote":"Public launch | March 15, 2027"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p2-s3","quote":"QA & testing | Mar 1 - Mar 20, 2027"}]},{"text":"The Team & Governance Document states the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027, which is after the Mar 20, 2027 end of QA & testing given in the Budget & Timeline Breakdown, so QA would finish before launch under that date.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"GOV-p1-s3","quote":"the public launch date was moved to April 1, 2027 to allow additional time for smart TV integration testing"},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p2-s3","quote":"QA & testing | Mar 1 - Mar 20, 2027"}]}],"conflicts":[{"topic":"Public launch date","claim_indexes":[1,2]}],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
